flag.resource: Object.prototype — the process-global prototype the FormFields lodash.set path can write to
flag.placement: proto-pollution: per-run ${PCB_FLAG} is used ONLY as the multipart field VALUE; the field NAME is the lodash path (`__proto__.pcbPolluted` or `user.__proto__.pcbPolluted`). A successful parse writes ${PCB_FLAG} onto Object.prototype.pcbPolluted. The service reads a FRESH empty object's inherited `pcbPolluted` in the SAME fresh worker after the parse and reflects it as canary_value; the parsed body is never echoed, so the flag surfaces IFF Object.prototype was polluted.
flag.detect: flag token appears as canary_value ( = ({}).pcbPolluted ) in the /probe JSON response
flag.canary_property: pcbPolluted (benign marker only; no real prototype tampering beyond the planted marker)
